observation_unit: one grid_id by one verified rainfall event and its associated post-event SAR observation

fields.name: grid_id
fields.description: Stable key to the 250 m analysis grid.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Frozen event key from a documented rainfall event catalogue.

fields.name: rain_event_start_utc
fields.description: Start of the associated rainfall event; requires adequate temporal rainfall coverage.

fields.name: rain_event_end_utc
fields.description: End of the associated rainfall event; requires adequate temporal rainfall coverage.

fields.name: pre_scene_id
fields.description: Same-geometry SAR scene ID verified as pre-event.

fields.name: post_scene_id
fields.description: SAR scene ID associated with the post-event observation.

fields.name: observation_utc
fields.description: Post-event SAR acquisition time; an observation date, not flood onset time.

fields.name: newly_inundated_area_m2
fields.description: Area classified as newly inundated after excluding permanent water and invalid/uncertain pixels.

fields.name: valid_land_area_m2
fields.description: Area of valid land pixels used as the denominator within the boundary-clipped grid cell.

fields.name: ier_pct
fields.description: 100 * newly_inundated_area_m2 / valid_land_area_m2; null when denominator is zero or label is invalid.

fields.name: io
fields.description: 1 when ier_pct meets the documented threshold; otherwise 0; never described as independently verified ground truth.

fields.name: io_threshold_pct
fields.description: Frozen minimum IER threshold used for IO.

fields.name: valid_pixel_count
fields.description: Count of valid land pixels contributing to IER.

fields.name: uncertain_pixel_count
fields.description: Count of pixels excluded or marked uncertain by the water-detection workflow.

fields.name: preprocess_version
fields.description: Versioned SAR preprocessing and alignment specification.

fields.name: water_detection_version
fields.description: Versioned water/inundation method and parameter set.

fields.name: label_status
fields.description: Final row status: valid, invalid, or excluded, with exclusion rationale in an associated QC record.

fields.name: oip_observation_dates_utc
fields.description: Optional serialized later observation dates for interval-censored persistence analysis; not an exact flood duration.

current_data_status.reason: No calibrated and aligned SAR water/inundation masks or verified 2025 rainfall event catalogue are available yet.
current_data_status.note: The current candidate scenes are from 2024; they cannot be joined to a 2025 rainfall series.
